old_caption: A small, glowing object with multiple spinning lights hovers in a dark, textured environment. The object emits a warm, golden light from its central body and its spinning components, creating a soft illumination against the dark background. The object remains relatively stationary throughout the sequence, with only slight, subtle movements. The surrounding environment is dark and indistinct, with faint, shifting shapes suggesting a rough, uneven surface below. The lighting and motion of the object are the primary visual elements.
original_wisa_caption:
The video opens with a dark, almost black background, creating an atmosphere of mystery and suspense. In the center of the frame, a small, glowing object appears, resembling a lantern or a firefly. This object emits a warm, golden light that gradually illuminates its surroundings. As the camera pans slowly to the right, the object reveals itself to be a small, intricately designed lantern floating on water. The lantern's light casts a gentle glow on the surface of the water, creating ripples and reflections that dance across the dark surface.

As the camera continues to pan, more details of the lantern become visible. It has a delicate, ornate design with intricate patterns etched into its surface. The lantern is tethered to a thin, flexible string, which extends outwards from it, suggesting it might be part of a larger setup or decoration. The water beneath the lantern is calm, with only slight disturbances caused by the lantern's gentle movement. The overall scene is serene and enchanting
caption:
A small multi-rotor craft is suspended near the center of a very dark frame. Its dark oval body has pale golden arms extending outward to spinning rotors. The rotor blades appear as soft blurred discs that fluctuate slightly in shape and orientation. The craft stays intact and about the same size while drifting slightly rightward across the view. The surrounding background remains mostly black, with faint uneven tones near the lower edge and sides, suggesting dim distant structures, low forms, and terrain that are barely visible in the deep darkness.

The spinning rotors continue to blur throughout the visible segment, clearly showing ongoing rotor motion without stopping. No takeoff, landing, collision, or structural change is shown within this excerpt at any visible point in it. The dim background gradually reveals faint horizontal bands and low shapes along the bottom and lower edge areas. The craft remains the main illuminated subject while the surrounding scene stays very low contrast and almost entirely dark throughout the view.
